notes.title: The demo of Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zMbbtTIX0MQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello there, gamers and readers!

Trinity Team and Excaliber are excited to announce a brand-new project: Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic!

What is Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic?

 The evolution of gamebooks: read the book and play the video game!
 A turn-based RPG inspired by the great classics
 An exciting adventure full of twists and surprises


Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic was created to innovate the gamebook experience. Players will read the story and make decisions from the physical book, while interactions will be managed through a video game on PC, consoles, or mobile devices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45511365/f7448912a60d40097ec1cd78b31ade82b0fd1a69.png

The Steam demo offers an adapted version of the experience: it includes a digital book chapter that guides you through the story’s paragraphs until the adventure fully unfolds. Once the quest begins, you will dive straight into the action - exploring dungeons, battling enemies, and uncovering treasures... for a taste of what awaits in the final game!

If you love the project, add Intermundia: Dungeons, Polygons & Magic to your wishlist! And be sure to follow us on Kickstarter- we will soon be launching our crowdfunding campaign with amazing rewards!

Feel free to reach out with any questions or suggestions: we can’t wait to read your comments!

Kickstarter Campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1684041218/intermundia-dungeons-polygons-and-magic
